formula.ascii: Layers are ordered bottom to top. n_j = clamp((x_j - min_j)/(max_j - min_j), 0, 1), replaced by 1 - n_j when the layer is inverted. The bottom layer is used as is: b_0 = n_0. For j >= 1: b_j = opacity_j * mode(n_j, b_{j-1}) + (1 - opacity_j) * b_{j-1}. Modes with foreground a = n_j and background b: normal and luminosity a; multiply a*b; screen 1-(1-a)(1-b); overlay (switches on the background) 2ab if b <= 0.5 else 1-(1-2(b-0.5))(1-a); soft-light (switches on the foreground) 2ba + b^2(1-2a) if a < 0.5 else 2b(1-a) + sqrt(b)(2a-1). Any non-finite layer value gives NaN.
